summary: The candidate's import-time MUSA predicate fixes the reproduced cold- and warm-cache TorchDynamo gb0069 failure and preserves tested MUSA truth semantics. However, its unrelated reordering of the prefill-CP topology check introduces a confirmed ROCm regression: is_dsa_enable_prefill_cp() raises before the parallel runtime namespace is published, whereas the base returns False through the HIP guard. Remove or safely constrain that reordering before acceptance. The original 8-GPU B200 MiniMax tc_piecewise deployment was unavailable and remains unverified.

tests.what_was_measured: Candidate raised ValueError because the parallel config namespace was not published; base exited 0 and returned False on ROCm.
A fullgraph ROCm Inductor kernel calling is_musa matched an independent NumPy reference with max absolute error 2.384185791015625e-07. Generated HSACO/AMDGCN targeted gfx950.

gpu_execution.evidence: One assigned AMD Instinct MI355X with PyTorch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 and HIP 7.2.26015. Generated artifact was elf64-amdgpu with EF_AMDGPU_MACH_AMDGCN_GFX950 and amdhsa.target amdgcn-amd-amdhsa--gfx950.

remaining_counterexamples: On ROCm before the parallel runtime namespace is published, candidate is_dsa_enable_prefill_cp() raises ValueError at get_parallel().attn_cp_size; base returns False by evaluating is_hip() first.
remaining_limitations: The original 8-GPU NVIDIA B200 MiniMax-M3 tc_piecewise prefill CUDA-graph deployment was unavailable; a one-GPU ROCm run does not qualify it.
MUSA hardware and the real torchada package were unavailable; predicate semantics were checked with a controlled importable module and torch.version.musa values.
No native C++ or FlyDSL source changed, so no native rebuild was applicable.
Raw logs, scripts, generated source references, and ISA evidence are preserved under /job/review-evidence-j-bf191fb120ca; compiler caches remained under /tmp outside the checkout.
